title: The Addams Family
about: The Addams family's long-lost Uncle Fester turns up, or does he.
cue: Serve the lemonade when Wednesday sets up her lemonade stand.
faces: THE DOORS ARE BARRED AT MIDNIGHT
Cemetery Lane, No Sunshine. Strange family. Fresh lemonade.
II. Cousin Itt in the hall.
Gomez, darling, dinner is ready. Fester is home, and he looks very well for a man who was lost.

The Mamushka dance at Fester's homecoming.

Grandmama stirring something in the kitchen.

    StartersThing's finger crackersButtery crackers shaped like fingers, with almond nailsHow to make it100g butter, cold200g plain flour1 egg20g flaked almondsRub the butter into the flour, then add the egg to form a dough.Roll into 16 finger shapes.Press a flaked almond into the tip of each and score knuckles with a knife.Bake at 180°C.Baked beetroot rose petal chipsPaper thin beetroot slices baked crisp with olive oil and flaky saltHow to make it3 beetroots2 tbsp olive oil1/2 tsp sea salt flakesSlice the beetroots paper thin on a mandoline.Toss with oil and spread on lined trays.Bake at 150°C until curled and crisp.Sprinkle with flaky salt.Mamushka herring and beetroot ryeThe Mamushka dance at Fester's homecomingHow to make itAs written, serves 4Dark rye toasts topped with pickled herring, sour cream and dill, and roast beetroot with horseradish cream, a Russian-style plate for the family dance.Wrap 3 beetroot in foil and roast at 200°C for 50 minutes, then peel and dice.Toast 8 slices dark rye and cut in half.Mix 100g sour cream with chopped dill.Mix 100g crème fraîche with 1 tbsp horseradish.Top half the toasts with dill cream and 200g pickled herring pieces and red onion.Top the rest with horseradish cream and beetroot.Finish with dill and pepper.MainsGomez's candlelit roastRib roast salted overnight with garlic and rosemary, roast potatoes, horseradishHow to make it2kg beef rib roast1 tsp salt3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp rosemary, chopped1kg potatoes2 tbsp horseradishSeason the beef with salt, garlic and rosemary overnight.Roast at 220°C.Lower to 160°C and roast until 52°C inside, adding the potatoes.Rest.Carve at the candlelit table with horseradish.Grandmama's cauldron beef stewGrandmama stirring something in the kitchenHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef shin braised black-dark in red wine with onion, carrot, garlic and mushrooms until it falls apart, ladled over buttery mash from a big black pot.Toss 1.2kg diced beef shin with 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches.Cook 2 onions, 2 carrots and 3 garlic cloves for 8 minutes.Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 375ml red wine, 500ml beef stock, thyme and bay.Return the beef, cover and cook at 160°C for 3 hours, adding 250g mushrooms for the last 30 minutes.Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 80g butter and 150ml milk.Serve from the pot.SweetsBlack forest cakeChocolate sponge layered with kirsch, cream and morello cherriesHow to make it4 eggs150g caster sugar120g self-raising flour30g cocoa45ml kirsch400ml thickened cream1 jar morello cherries100g dark chocolateWhisk the eggs with the sugar until thick, then fold in the flour and cocoa.Bake at 175°C.Cool and split the cake.Brush with cherry syrup and kirsch.Whip the cream and layer with the cherries.Shave dark chocolate on top.DrinksWednesday's blackberry lemonadeBlackberry and fresh lemon lemonade over ice with mintHow to make it300g frozen blackberries150ml sugar syrup5 lemons, juiced1 L cold water2 cups ice4 sprigs of mintBlend the blackberries with the syrup and lemon juice.Strain through a sieve, pressing hard.Pour into a jug with the cold water and stir.Chill.Serve over ice with a few whole blackberries, a lemon slice and a mint sprig.
